heroHeadline: Houthis Claim Missile Strike on Riyadh as Explosions Rock Saudi Capital; Turkey Refuses Troop Deployment
heroSubtitle: Houthi forces claimed a direct missile strike on Riyadh with explosions heard across the Saudi capital — the most significant Houthi attack on the capital in months. Turkey ruled out deploying troops to Yemen despite its Mecca pact with Saudi Arabia, clarifying the limits of regional alliance commitments.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
